CURRENT SCENE:
你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。

ITEMS:

[I64] 你【不是】当数学家   correction: 不是 → 不要   strength: error
  checker's note: advice/prohibition needs 不要, not 不是
  rule card (not_but_refutation, Coherence: connectors): Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 不是……而是…… must refute a mistaken or expected idea and give its correction; <first alternative> is not conventionally related to <second alternative>.  Her terms: 不是……而是……, Subj.
  her past correction: 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction: 他[-那]不是成为医生
  her past correction: [-他]难怪成为了一个很聪明的哲学家

[I65] 【而是】当哲学家   correction: 而是 → 而要   strength: error
  checker's note: 不要 should pair with 而要 in this contrast
  rule card (fixed_expressions, Vocabulary): Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use the established expression <correct>, not the literal/nonstandard combination <wrong>.  Her terms: 从 + Place, 制定规定, 自然规律, Subj.算是Obj., 只/不过/才(+num.) + 而已
  her past correction: 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]
  her past correction: 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction: 哲学人很聪明[和→也很]重要 — her note: 和cannot connect Adj.

[I66] 而是当哲学家【^】   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: suggestion
  rule card (become_and_profession, Vocabulary): 成为 is followed by an appropriate N., especially a profession or public identity: 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity). For becoming successful or capable, use 成才.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 成为 needs an appropriate noun, such as a profession or public identity; for becoming capable or successful, use 成才.  Her terms: 成为+N, 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity), 成为 + profession/celebrity
  her past correction: 成为很聪明[+的哲学家]
  her past correction: 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction: [+就]开始学哲学 — her note: 才 Num.就V.

[I67] 所以他们又搬家【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred

[I68] 在他们第三个家【^】   correction: ∅ → 里   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: a modified 家 usually needs 里 for a location
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 他跟他的妈妈住在一个小房子[+里] — her note: 在Place
  her past correction: 在新的房子[+里] — her note: 在+Place
  her past correction: 在[第三个房子→第三个地方]

[I69] 孟子学【^】了怎么祭拜   correction: ∅ → 会   strength: suggestion
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: [+就]开始祭拜 — her note: 才 Num.就V.
  her past correction: 从早到晚孟子跟小朋友看[+别人]祭拜
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧一直祭拜 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I70] 告诉【了】孟子：我们找到了最后的家   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: no 了 after the speaking verb 告诉
  rule card (no_le_speaking_word, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): A speaking word that introduces quoted speech normally uses no particle, not 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <speaking word> introduces quoted speech, so use no 了.  Her terms: no了for speaking word introducing quoted speech, no 了for speaking word, no了for speaking word
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 孟母和孟子住[了→在那儿]很高兴

[I71] 【他难怪】成为有名的哲学家   correction: 他难怪 → 难怪他   strength: error
  checker's note: 难怪 normally comes before the subject it explains
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 难怪他成为[名的→有名的]哲学家
  her past correction: [-他]难怪成为了一个很聪明的哲学家
  her past correction: 难怪他长大以后[当→成为]很有名的哲学家

items.explanation: This is advice or prohibition, so use 不要, not 不是. 不是……而是…… refutes a mistaken idea and gives the correction.
With 不要 in this contrast, use 而要: 不要……而要…….
It would be more natural to say 哲学家的, so the phrase clearly describes the kind of person.
It would be more natural to add 了 because the move is completed in the story (了completed).
It would be more natural to add 里 after this modified place: 在他们第三个家里.
It would be more natural to say 学会了, meaning that Mencius learned how to perform the ritual.
告诉 introduces quoted speech, so use no 了 after this speaking word.
Put 难怪 before the subject it explains: 难怪他成为有名的哲学家.
